acceptance.explanation: The 248,577 native Gaia young-star points retain their individual colors, sky positions and adopted 150 pc heights. Only the resolved share changes from 1.96% to 20%; it replaces unresolved light rather than adding luminosity. The combined blue-grain error falls by 65%, but I2, D2, D5 and D6 become too coarse, and I3 also moves farther from its measured contrast. An explicit 0–60% share audit in 1% steps finds no setting that improves all seven pins. This version is rejected: l32 remains the base for l34. A population-wide grain amplitude cannot reconcile those regional differences; no spatial weights or photo-derived star positions were fitted. Colors, dust and all other structure stay fixed.
